name: Tsuma no Haha Sayuri
source:
The main character is a white-collar worker. He has a wife, but she runs away from home. When he is at a loss what to do, Sayuri, his wife's mother, reaches out for him, "I'll replace her... Please..." As he lives with her, he gradually falls in love with her, and so does she...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
主人公是一名上班族，已有妻子，妻子却离家出走。就在他不知所措时，岳母小百合向他伸出援手：“让我代替她吧…求你了…”共同生活的过程中，主人公渐渐爱上小百合，而她也对他产生了感情…

[摘自ErogeShop]
